labelling_note: subagent_tokens are MEASURED totals for the whole agent session (reading, scripting, self-verification) and therefore an UPPER BOUND on what a purpose-built extractor would use per document. Costs derived from these figures are ESTIMATES at published per-token prices and must be labelled as such everywhere. wall_ms is harness-inclusive wall clock.

process_notes_discovery: Two agents disclosed over-scoped Grep calls (document filenames/text only; answer keys never touched).
Shared-working-folder collision: one agent executed a sibling batch's leftover script; outputs verified unaffected. Future waves use uniquely-named scratch files.

FBL3N agent initially mis-sliced wide right-aligned amounts (leading-digit loss) before switching to token-pattern parsing - recorded because it is the exact failure mode the regression gate exists to catch.
ME2M agent handled a vendor subtotal printed after a page break (form feed between a vendor's rows and its Summe line).

findings: 3 FBL3N parses failed schema validation (integer-typed header codes) -> pipeline-mandated retry, costed separately below.

13 field errors (purch_org/sales_org captured as the whole line, e.g. '1000   Jalavakoski Konepaja Oy' vs '1000'): root cause is BRIEF DRIFT - the fallback prompts dropped the discovery prompts' 'the number after' qualifier. These pass schema and stand in the record as shipped LLM-path errors: fallback wave field accuracy 99.96% vs discovery 100%. Lesson: deterministic accuracy is a property of code; LLM accuracy is a property of the brief - version your briefs.

overseer_generation_wave.note: One-time cost: parser-writer agents (the overseer's code-generation step), one per transaction type. Regression gate itself is deterministic Python (negligible).

pricing_reference.note: Introductory pricing ($2/$10) runs through 2026-08-31; estimates use standard list prices. subagent_tokens are undifferentiated totals, so costs are computed as a BAND (all-input floor to all-output ceiling) plus a central estimate assuming an 85/15 input/output split (agent sessions are input-heavy). All figures are estimates and labelled as such.

retry_wave.reason: schema failure: integer-typed identifier fields in 3 FBL3N variant parses
